name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2485: FLOWING was unreachable: the score map is keyed on organ ids while the lookup uses lane names, two disjoint vocabularies, so no vessel could ever turn FLOWING however much sabotage was done. Measured both ways - scoring every organ leaves it at 0, scoring every watcher turns 11. The row now derives whether a score could land and says which kind of not-proven it is. It does not build the lane scorer; that is the rest of A1 and is not claimed.
